closed-datum-tasks.text: The story, requirements and rulings are in the specification and the ruling page; decisions and hosted checks are in the plan; the files this work may change are in the touch list.

slice-the-closed-datum-entry-point.text: [ ] closed-validator-appended: the closed-datum validator follows the last line of open_datum.ak, with no other change to the file.
[ ] closed-spend-refuses-every-update: the suite shows the closed spend refusing an update of every payload in its list, in contexts open-datum accepts.
[ ] closed-refusal-is-the-closed-rule: each such refusal is paired, in the same test file, with open-datum's acceptance of the same context.
[ ] closed-release-follows-open-release: a release in the registry's terminating fold is accepted, together with the registry's own validator, and a release outside it is refused.
[ ] closed-booking-follows-open-booking: insertion and termination bookings are accepted, and a refused booking is refused with the same verdict as open-datum's.
[ ] closed-else-refuses: another script purpose is refused.
[ ] closed-refusal-test-can-fail: the composed-suite check names a closed refusal test in its log and refuses a planted copy whose closed Update arm accepts.
[ ] closed-identity-pinned-from-the-build: the manifest gains the three closed rows from the real blueprint, and the three open-datum rows are unedited.
[ ] seventeen-validators-in-the-release: the merged blueprint check and the release assembler count seventeen.
[ ] declared-additions-recorded: the record names exactly the three closed titles.

[ ] comparison-admits-only-what-is-declared: the comparison admits the declared titles, refuses an undeclared extra validator and a moved declared hash, and keeps every base hash byte-identical; both plants run on every invocation.
[ ] boundary-contexts-unchanged: the permanent boundary still receives four application contexts.
[ ] pages-and-speech-stamped: the pages of this folder carry current speech.
[ ] local-legs-green: the cheap local commands in the plan pass on the final head.
[ ] hosted-jobs-green: every job in the plan's table is green on the pushed head, and the acceptance walk records each job's run.
